name: adaptive-evidence-state-branching
control: Competent conventional investigator may adapt queries and follow leads freely under equal time and full obligations; no artificial static-query prohibition.
treatment: Maintain parent-child search branch states tied to propositions affecting product recommendation, applicability, plan correction or useful alternative. After each retrieval record supported/refuted/conditional/unknown transitions and new conditions/options/duplicates. Give next retrieval attention to observed state change per minute (+4 consequential proposition transition,+2 new applicability condition,+2 viable alternative,-2 duplicate). Preserve one unresolved countercase branch AND obligation/alternative coverage floor; zero-change branches can pause only after all mandatory research coverage accounted for. This explicit adaptive allocation is an inference-time adaptation, not IGRPO training/reward reproduction. Complete full scope and same critic/reviser.
novelty: Iterated parent-child evidence-state utility allocates search attention; distinct from static critical-first and more parallel scouts; control remains competent and adaptive.
adaptation_limit: Paper/implementation mechanisms motivate the intervention; published benchmark gains are NOT ER11 evidence.
